rows.title_short: \"The Subdivision and Condominium Buyers' Protective Decree Amendments of 2005.\"
rows.abstract: \"The Subdivision and Condominium Buyers' Protective Decree Amendments of 2005\". The bill proposes the following amendments, among others: a) the cancellation of the registration with the Register of Deeds of a contract to sell that has been rescinded will not longer require a court order but simply an affidavit, and b) the deed of sale or contract to sell a lot or unit, subject of a mortgage, will be required to include a partial release clause or a provision guaranteeing the release of the title upon full payment.

rows.title_short: \"Subdivision Green Parks Act of 2005.\"
rows.abstract: \"Subdivisions Green Parks Act of 2005\". The bill mandates the owner or developer of a subdivision project to plant trees in the open spaces reserved for the common use and enjoyment of lot owners and along roads. It directs the Department of Natural Resources and Environment and the Housing and Land Use Regulatory Board to determine the number of trees to be planted and the size of the green park.

rows.title_short: Movie and Television Classifications Board or MTRCB Act of 2005
rows.abstract: \"Movie and Television Classifications Board or MTCB Act of 2005\". The bill seeks to abolish the Movie and Television Review and Classification Board (MTRCB) and creates, in its place, the MTCB.
